homePageContent:
Salmefelt blends ancient Estonian felting traditions with playful modern design. 100% natural sheep-wool sauna hats are made with wet-felting technique.

A sauna hat is not just an accessory; it's your ultimate shield in the steam room. 

Handcrafted felt hats offer unparalleled benefits:
• Premium thermal protection: Natural wool acts as an ideal insulator, protecting your head, hair, and ears from intense heat while keeping your head cool.
• Lightweight and breathable: Expertly wet felted to be light and comfortable on the head without losing its dense protective properties.
• Playful and unique designs: From our signature, popular felt fish and shark hats to timeless and elegant styles, each hat is a unique work of art.

My creativity began in the coastal village of Salme, at a historic Viking ship crossing. I have been inspired by simple juniper-covered sheep pastures where fishermen laid their fish traps for repair. It's captivating to pass on the wisdom and experience of our ancestors through warm, and homely items made with ancient felting techniques. I am grateful to my parents, family, friends, and everyone who appreciates this art!

Discover my sauna hats and other creations in my [Etsy store](https://www.etsy.com/shop/salmefelt) or contact [me](mailto:salmefelt@gmail.com) directly.
